title: Advanced Software Architecture
description: Evolutionary architecture, architectural decision records, design patterns, C4 model, domain-driven design, and system design for large-scale financial platforms.

title: Distributed Systems Engineering
description: CAP theorem, distributed consensus, consistency models, clock synchronization, partition tolerance, and designing fault-tolerant distributed financial systems.

title: Concurrency & Thread Safety Engineering
description: Java Memory Model, thread safety, synchronization primitives, atomic operations, lock-free algorithms, virtual threads, and concurrent financial data processing.

title: Banking & Financial Systems Architecture
description: Core banking architecture, payment processing, SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, real-time payments, FX, settlement, and cross-border payment systems.

title: Financial Transaction Integrity & Ledger Engineering
description: Idempotency, dual-write problems, Outbox pattern, double-entry ledger engineering, concurrent balance management, and preventing financial data corruption.

title: High Availability, Reliability & Resilience
description: Circuit breakers, bulkheads, chaos engineering, multi-region architecture, disaster recovery, SLO/SLA design, and error budget management.

title: Performance Engineering & JVM Internals
description: JVM internals, garbage collection analysis, JMH benchmarking, memory profiling, database query optimization, and tuning high-throughput financial services.

title: Database & Data Architecture
description: ACID properties, MVCC, transaction isolation levels, row-level locking, optimistic/pessimistic locking, PostgreSQL internals, and financial database design.

title: Messaging, Streaming & Enterprise Integration
description: Apache Kafka architecture, exactly-once semantics, Outbox pattern, CDC, Event Sourcing, CQRS, Saga pattern, and event-driven financial processing.

title: Cloud, Infrastructure & Platform Engineering
description: Kubernetes orchestration, Docker containerization, cloud architecture patterns, GitOps, service mesh, and platform engineering for financial services.

title: Security, Observability & Production Engineering
description: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, Prometheus/Grafana, JVM diagnostics, security engineering, incident management, and production readiness for financial systems.

title: Staff & Principal Engineering Leadership
description: Technical strategy, RFC process, architectural decision-making, mentoring senior engineers, cross-team influence, and the Staff/Principal engineer operating model.

title: Spring Boot 4 for Senior Fintech Engineers
description: Spring Boot 4, Spring Framework 7, virtual thread integration, Spring Data 4, Spring Security 7, Spring Kafka 4, and migrating production fintech services from Spring Boot 3.x.

title: System Design for Fintech Interviews
description: End-to-end system design walkthroughs: payment processing, fraud detection, financial ledger, rate limiting, and distributed systems trade-offs.

title: Interview Playbook
description: STAR stories, running the 45-minute design round, the top 60 Java/Spring/fintech questions, and ten timed mock interviews with rubrics.

title: First 90 Days
description: A senior engineer's 30/60/90 plan: reading an unfamiliar Spring codebase with Actuator, first PR, on-call readiness and safe database migrations.

title: Final Interview Prep
description: A 12-hour final sprint for senior and staff FinTech interviews: 500 technical and architectural Q&As, 10 tested coding challenges, 100 scenario-based self-test questions and 300 high-impact interview tips.
